snippet.title: SPLATCHINKO Official Teaser Trailer 2026 | Wishlist Now
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3802500/Splatchinko/

Welcome to Splatchinko
This early gameplay trailer showcases the chaotic, psychedelic world of Splatchinko’s upcoming demo.
Dodge cosmic hazards, fight bizarre space creatures, and survive boards that feel like they were designed by a malfunctioning galaxy.
This is only the beginning. More chaos is coming.

STEAMのウィッシュリスト: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3802500/Splatchinko/

ようこそ、Splatchinko
このトレーラーでは、デモ版のアーリーゲームプレイを初公開。
宇宙の狂った仕掛け、奇妙すぎる敵、そして銀河が壊れたようなカオスのボードを体験してください。
これは序章にすぎない。混沌はまだ続く。
